NEOW.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: [sine]...a feather...from a distant sky...has also sunk...into the Spire...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: If death has not discharged my duty, then let me stand once more.
NEOW.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: [sine]...shields will break...wings will fracture...and still...you return?[/sine]
NEOW.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: As long as someone behind me still needs protection.
NEOW.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: [sine]...your old flock...is gone...your new flock...will one day follow...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: Loss does not make an oath meaningless.
DARV.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: A greatshield and a halberd—good taste! I've got a few old pieces in my collection that can take a beating. Come pick one!
DARV.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: If it can protect a companion, I will put it to use again.
DARV.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: Back for the sturdiest stuff again? I dug out the old stock I'd been saving at the bottom of the chest!
DARV.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: Anything that can take a blow for a companion should not stay buried in a chest.
DARV.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: I found an old crest! Its wing looks just like the pattern on your armor.
DARV.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]The Guardian tucks the crest inside his cuirass.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2r.ancient: Keep it safe. Treasure is for remembering what must not be forgotten!
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: Knight of the Pinionfolk, you have crossed the long night to stand before me. Accept power, and let your shield grow stronger.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: Power that cannot shelter another is merely another burden.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: Your wings are broken. Why do you still place yourself at the very front?
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: One wing is enough to ride the wind. One shield is enough to bear an oath.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: Had you possessed your present strength in the past, perhaps your old flock would still live.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: Perhaps. But conjecture cannot rewrite the fate of the dead.
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2r.ancient: Then choose the power that can protect the present.
OROBAS.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: Bird! Shield! Halberd! One wing missing? Strange, very strange! Can you still fly!?
OROBAS.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: Not as I once did. But I can still stand.
OROBAS.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: Shiny shield! Big eye sees many cracks! Want me to touch it!?
OROBAS.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: Leave your blessing upon the shield. It needs mending more than my scars do.
OROBAS.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: Two flocks! One dead, one living! Not the same flock, right!?
OROBAS.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: They were never replacements for one another. Together, they shape my oath.
OROBAS.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2r.ancient: Yes! The eye remembers! The shield remembers! Take this, and keep remembering!
PAEL.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Broken-winged friend...put down your shield and rest a while...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: I can rest. I cannot put down the shield.
PAEL.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]There is always a storm in your dreams...aren't you tired...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: I am. Yet when I wake, I can still guard them.
PAEL.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]You carry the dead upon your wings...that is too heavy, friend...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: They are not a burden. They are names.
PAEL.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2r.ancient: [thinky_dots]Then sleep...and let those names rest here for a moment too...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: [b]A great bird-knight! A huge shield and a long halberd! Fine weapons should be used in battle!![/b]
TANX.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: If a contest can prove the weapons reliable, I accept.
TANX.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: [b]Ram me with your shield, then summon a whirlwind! Show me everything!![/b]
TANX.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: First, stand firm. The fiercer the assault, the wider its opening.
TANX.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: [b]Another match, Pinionfolk! This time I will get around your shield!![/b]
TANX.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]Halberd and claw clash again and again. The great shield never retreats half a step.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2r.ancient: [b]Excellent! You even protect your own halberd perfectly! Take the weapon. We continue next time!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: Oh, what lovely old wounds. Come, little bird. Let me [jitter][b]burn away[/b][/jitter] the curse upon that broken wing.
TEZCATARA.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: The scars remind me why I raise my shield. Save your flame for the blade.
TEZCATARA.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: Still carrying all that grief? A little fire would make it light as ash.
TEZCATARA.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: No. Teach me to master flame, not to burn away an oath.
TEZCATARA.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: Your feathers carry the scent of ancient magic... Did you truly forgive the witch who forged that curse?
TEZCATARA.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: I chose to protect the companion who still lives. Forgiveness demanded more courage than vengeance.
TEZCATARA.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2r.ancient: Well said, dear. Fire need not only destroy. It can light a road for the lost.
VAKUU.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: The last feather, carrying an entire fallen flock. Want to bargain, and see them fly again?
VAKUU.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: I will not wager the living's safety in a bargain with a demon.
VAKUU.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0r.ancient: Your new flock will die too. When they do, whom will that shield hide?
VAKUU.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1r.char: Before that day, you will have to pass through me.
VAKUU.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0r.ancient: If you had been stronger, your old comrades would not have fallen. Admit it: you failed them.
VAKUU.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1r.char: I did. I neither flee that failure nor permit you to exploit it.
VAKUU.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2r.ancient: How dull. Go find the Architect, then. Let me see how long that shield holds.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.0-0.ancient: Last knight of the Pinionfolk. Was it that great shield which carried you to the summit?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.0-1.char: Not the shield. The companions behind it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.1-0.ancient: Your old flock will not return because of this victory.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.1-1.ancient: If the past cannot be restored, why cling to that oath?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.1-2.char: The dead do not need me to rebuild the past. The living need me to defend the present.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.2-0.ancient: Should the long night end here, your duty will end with it.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.2-1.char: Protection is not a command given to me by the night. It is my choice.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.2-2.ancient: Then show me how firmly your choice can stand.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.3-0r.ancient: Every shield will break. What remains when yours does?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUARDIAN.3-1r.char: Wings remain behind the shield. Beyond the wings, the oath remains.
NEOW.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: [sine]...you study every footprint...does any one...belong to the one you seek...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: The trail was cleaned. First, I find who did it.
NEOW.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: [sine]...you have held the bow so long...does your hand...not shake...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.IRONEYE.1-1r.char: It does. Not enough to matter before the shot.
NEOW.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: [sine]...if that person...finally stood before you...would you ask...or shoot...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: Verify first. When it is time to shoot, no question is needed.
DARV.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: Archer! Look at these old pieces. Buckles hold, edges are straight—I checked them myself!
DARV.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: State their provenance first. That wax seal is still intact.
DARV.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: Back again? I set aside some lighter wares for you, before that quiver drags you to the floor!
DARV.talk.IRONEYE.1-1r.char: Give me the inventory. Weight is not the only concern.
DARV.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: I found this crescent-marked piece of metal in the old collection. If you can read those cuts, take it!
DARV.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]Ironeye clears the dust, checking each groove, chip, and patch of rust in turn.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.IRONEYE.2-2r.ancient: Knew I saved it for the right one! Next time, tell me what that mark does.
NONUPEIPE.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: Archer, take this power. It will make your arrows faster.
NONUPEIPE.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: A test shot first. Speed does not guarantee a hit.
NONUPEIPE.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: You never offer your back to another. Does keeping watch alone not exhaust you?
NONUPEIPE.talk.IRONEYE.1-1r.char: A habit. It does not interfere with the work.
NONUPEIPE.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: If a companion left at midnight carrying your arrows, would you chase them or count the quiver first?
NONUPEIPE.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: Count the arrows, then check the tracks. Keep the order.
NONUPEIPE.talk.IRONEYE.2-2r.ancient: Good. Take this power, but do not let it skip that step for you.
OROBAS.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: Hood! White hair! Blue eyes! So many arrows behind you! How many eyes do you see on me!?
OROBAS.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: Twelve. The third from the left just blinked.
OROBAS.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: Curved blade leaves a mark, then an arrow breaks it! Will the wound remember you!?
OROBAS.talk.IRONEYE.1-1r.char: The target needs to remember only one thing: its opening is exposed.
OROBAS.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: Always searching, always looking! What if the betrayer hides where you cannot see!?
OROBAS.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: Follow the trail. Unseen does not mean absent.
OROBAS.talk.IRONEYE.2-2r.ancient: Good eye! Take this, and make hiding harder!
PAEL.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Quiet archer...ease the string...no one can approach from behind in a dream...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: The string can rest. The bow stays within reach.
PAEL.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]Even asleep, you count each breath...who taught you to fear trust so deeply...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.IRONEYE.1-1r.char: A habit. Do not give it another meaning.
PAEL.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]That arrow chasing truth...if it never finds a mark, how long will you keep the bow drawn...?[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: Enough for tonight. I resume at dawn.
PAEL.talk.IRONEYE.2-2r.ancient: [thinky_dots]Then close your eyes for now...even a wakeful gaze needs a moment of darkness...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: [b]Hiding at a distance is no fight! Drop the longbow and bring me that curved blade!![/b]
TANX.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: Fine. Do not mistake a lowered bow for an opportunity.
TANX.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: [b]Stop staring at my openings! Face me head-on!![/b]
TANX.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: [b]This time I will dodge your first arrow, your second, and your third!![/b]
TANX.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]The first two arrows seal the exits. The third lands on the only step left to Tanx.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.IRONEYE.2-2r.ancient: [b]Good shot! Better trap! Take the weapon. Next time, I choose the battlefield!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: Such a calm gaze. Let me light a fire and burn away those troublesome [jitter][b]questions[/b][/jitter] inside you.
TEZCATARA.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: No need. Questions are evidence too.
TEZCATARA.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: The traitor you hunt may already be ash. Why not burn the obsession with them?
TEZCATARA.talk.IRONEYE.1-1r.char: Then I will search the ash. No trace would be more suspicious.
TEZCATARA.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: You bury anger very deeply, dear. Do you not fear it will one day burst from the string?
TEZCATARA.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: Anger does not choose my target.
TEZCATARA.talk.IRONEYE.2-2r.ancient: Good. Then let my fire illuminate the arrow's path, not choose it for you.
VAKUU.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: I know who betrayed you. One name for the least remarkable arrow in your quiver. Cheap, yes?
VAKUU.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: An unverified name is not worth one arrow.
VAKUU.talk.IRONEYE.1-0r.ancient: Still verifying? Truth will not wait. Give me a little trust, and I will give you absolute certainty.
VAKUU.talk.IRONEYE.1-1r.char: The harder you press me to believe, the more closely I check.
VAKUU.talk.IRONEYE.2-0r.ancient: What if your companion truly is the traitor? Could you put an arrow through his heart before he speaks?
VAKUU.talk.IRONEYE.2-1r.char: First, I verify. If he deserves death, speaking will not change that.
VAKUU.talk.IRONEYE.2-2r.ancient: Infuriatingly careful. Ask the Architect, then, and see whether its answer deserves an arrow.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.0-0.ancient: You measured every crack and counted every guard. What did you find?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.0-1.char: Four exits. You sealed only three.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.1-0.ancient: You call suspicion a duty, and pursuit an investigation.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.1-1.ancient: What if, at the end of your trail, you discover there was never a betrayal?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.1-2.char: Then the job ends. I find who forged the order.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.2-0.ancient: When the long night ends, whom will you hunt?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.2-1.char: Another job. Preferably one without killing.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.2-2.ancient: You even prepared for a life without enemies.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.3-0r.ancient: You return again and again. Still searching for new evidence?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONEYE.3-1r.char: Checking the route. That guard moved half a step left.
NEOW.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: [sine]...one soul...and three shadows...which leads the others...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: I give the order. My family chooses whether to answer. Do not confuse the two.
NEOW.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: [sine]...you pluck the strings...and the dead rise...do they consent...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: My family chooses. The enemy dead have no right to bargain with me.
NEOW.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: [sine]...when vengeance ends...will the lyre still sing...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: It will. Vengeance is only one song.
DARV.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: An old lyre! Let me see—the pegs are loose, but the frame is sound. I have just the parts for it.
DARV.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: Touch only the pegs. Leave the third string as it is.
DARV.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: Back again? I left the strings alone this time. Just wrapped the foot in soft leather so Sebastian needn't polish it all night.
DARV.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: Adequate. Sebastian will inspect it once more.
DARV.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: I found an old metronome, but it starts ticking whenever you come near. Take it—I cannot sleep with that thing!
DARV.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]The metronome stops the moment it touches her palm. Helen's laugh sounds behind her.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.REVENANT.2-2r.ancient: It was waiting for her! All the more reason you should have it.
NONUPEIPE.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: Pale musician, accept my power. It will make your dead more fearsome.
NONUPEIPE.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: Give it to Frederick first. He knows how to make power obey.
NONUPEIPE.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: Your family takes wounds in your place, yet you do not command them to stay. Why?
NONUPEIPE.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: They are neither weapons nor prisoners. If they wish to leave, I will not stop them.
NONUPEIPE.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: With enough power, you could keep everyone you lost beside you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: Keeping the dead captive is not restoration.
NONUPEIPE.talk.REVENANT.2-2r.ancient: Good. Then choose a power they can use.
OROBAS.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: One, two, three, four! No, there are more behind you! How many people did you bring!?
OROBAS.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: Three family members. The rest are merely borrowed dead.
OROBAS.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: A talking pumpkin! A skeleton in a hat! The one with the thin sword is so fast! Can I play with them!?
OROBAS.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: Ask Helen first. And do not touch Sebastian.
OROBAS.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: There is a door inside your lyre! So many footsteps behind it! Will they all fit out here!?
OROBAS.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: The strings release only what I need. Enough.
OROBAS.talk.REVENANT.2-2r.ancient: Clever! Take this and let the next one out faster!
PAEL.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: Helen does. She refuses to say what she dreams.
PAEL.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]When the music stops...do you hear silence...or the sound of them leaving...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: I know the difference. No reminder is needed.
PAEL.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]They may all stay tonight...I will watch the door...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: Leave one lamp. Do not wake them.
PAEL.talk.REVENANT.2-2r.ancient: [thinky_dots]All right...the lamp will stay lit...and the door shut...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: [b]Musician! Call the big pumpkin! I want to test his hammer!![/b]
TANX.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: Mind your words. If Frederick wishes, he will answer you himself.
TANX.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: [b]The tall skeleton next! Let him catch me with those huge hands!![/b]
TANX.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: Wipe your boots first. Sebastian permits no filth near him.
TANX.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: [b]You fight too! Do not just stand back there playing music!![/b]
TANX.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: [i][font_size=22]The Revenant plucks a string. Three spirits close in at once, forcing Tanx back into place.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.REVENANT.2-2r.ancient: [b]Four against one! Good! Next time I bring help too!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: Dear, your strings are cold as grave soil. Let me add a little [jitter][b]fire[/b][/jitter]. The dead will dance faster.
TEZCATARA.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: Take your hands from the lyre. It has no need of your fire.
TEZCATARA.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: Vengeance needs more than that slow dirge. Have you no angrier song?
TEZCATARA.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: I do. No one who heard it has asked twice.
TEZCATARA.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: If your enemy kneels and begs, will you quench the flame or burn the whole Spire with them?
TEZCATARA.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: Fire need only know my enemy's name. Burning an inch more would be incompetence.
TEZCATARA.talk.REVENANT.2-2r.ancient: Such restraint. Very well, I will keep the flame low.
VAKUU.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: I can return one spirit to life. Breath, age, everything. Give me the other three.
VAKUU.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: You made my family the price. This bargain is over.
VAKUU.talk.REVENANT.1-0r.ancient: They die for you again and again. Are you sure that is loyalty, not exhaustion?
VAKUU.talk.REVENANT.1-1r.char: Let them answer for themselves. Come closer.
VAKUU.talk.REVENANT.2-0r.ancient: And after you kill your enemy? Without vengeance, you are an empty shell clutching an old lyre.
VAKUU.talk.REVENANT.2-1r.char: When my enemies are dead, I decide where this body goes.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.0-0.ancient: You brought my dead to the summit. Do they obey you?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.0-1.char: Necros obey the strings. My family answers only the summons they accept.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.1-0.ancient: You call them family, yet let them suffer death in your place again and again.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.1-1.ancient: Is that love, or your refusal to face loss alone?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.1-2.char: Both. Admitting it does not lessen my duty.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.2-0.ancient: Your enemy is ahead. When the music stops, what do you mean to leave behind?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.2-1.char: My enemy's grave. And a road home for my family.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.2-2.ancient: You prepared a place for what comes after vengeance.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.3-0r.ancient: You again. Do those dead still choose to return with you?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.REVENANT.3-1r.char: They choose for themselves. Your guards cannot.
